q: The active voice of “It has to be done by you” is -
o: You have to do it.
You must do it.
You has to do it.
You have done it.

q: I decided to write an announcement. (Make it passive)
o: I decided that an announcement should be written.
I decided that an announcement has to be written.
I decided that an announcement should have written.
I decided an announcement had to be written.

q: The workers demanded to increase their salaries. (make it passive)
o: The workers demanded that their salaries are being increased.
The workers demand their salaries should be increased.
The workers are demanded that their salaries should be increased.
The workers demanded that their salaries should be increased.

q: We always remember the freedom fighters. Which of the following is the best passive form of the above sentence?
o: We are always remembered by the freedom fighters.
The freedom fighters will always be remembered by us.
The freedom fighters are always being remembered.
The freedom fighters are always remembered by us.

q: Change the voice: Buy him a car.

o: Let the way have been shown by me.
Let the way to be shown by me.

q: What is the active form of: "The letter is being written by John."?

q: Who has taken my pen? [Change the voice]

q: Choose the passive form of the sentence "I saw him playing football".
o: Football was seen played by me and him.
Football was being played and seen by him
He was seen playing football by me.

q: You must finish the homework. (Make it passive)
o: The homework must have to be finished by you.
The homework must be finished by you.

o: The law should been obeyed.

q: Change the voice of the following sentence: Plumeria smells sweet.
o: Plumeria is sweet when it smelled.
Plumeria is sweet when it is being smelled.
Plumeria is sweet when it is smelled.
Plumeria is sweet when it smells.
e: Plumeria smells sweet-এ smell ক্রিয়াটি active হলেও অর্থে passive, এ ধরনের বাক্যকে quasi-passive বলে। এর passive করতে subject একই থাকে, তারপর be verb ও adjective, এরপর when it/they এবং be verb-সহ মূল verb-এর past participle বসে। তাই Plumeria is sweet when it is smelled শুদ্ধ। Being smelled-এ চলমান ভাব আসায় অর্থ বদলে যায়।

q: Make it passive: The cake tastes delicious.
o: The cake is delicious to taste.
The cake is delicious if it is tasted.
The cake is delicious when it is tasted.
The cake be delicious as it is tasted.

q: The man fans himself. (make it passive)
o: The man was fanned by himself.
The man was fanned.
The man is fanned by himself.
The man is faned by himself.

q: Change the voice : 'He had eaten rice before I went there.''
o: He had been eaten rice before I went there
Rice had been eaten by him before I was gone by there.
Rice had been eaten by him before I went there.
Rice had been eaten by him before I had gone there.

q: The correct passive form of: Who will teach us English?
o: By whom will we be taught English?
English will be taught by who?
By whom English will be taught?
By whom we will be taught English?

q: Who broke the window? (Make it passive)
o: By whom was the window broken?
Who was the window broken by?
The window was broken by whom?
Both ক & খ
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যকে passive করার দুটি নিয়ম আছে: By whom + was/were + object + V3? এবং Who + was/were + object + V3 + by? তাই Who broke the window?-এর passive হতে পারে By whom was the window broken? এবং Who was the window broken by? দুটিই শুদ্ধ। The window was broken by whom? এই বিন্যাস প্রচলিত নয়।

q: Change the voice: He was born in 1960.
o: His mother bears him in 1960.
His mother borns him in 1960.
His mother born him in 1960.
His mother bore him in 1960.

q: I know that he stole my purse. (Make it passive)
o: It is known to me that my purse was stolen by him.
My purse was stolen by him and I knew it.
That my purse was stolen by him was known by me.
I knew that my purse was stolen by him.
